Callout.Name: Possible Lab in the Desert
Callout.Message: Chemical smell and generators reported at a remote property.
Callout.Advisory: No persons seen, lights on at night.

Script.Line: Generators running all night. You can hear them from the highway.
There is a smell takes the back of your throat off.
Nobody has come out of there. Not once in three days.

Lines.Approach: Generators running all night and a smell you would not forget. Nobody has seen a soul.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
